name: Recup
description: Électronicien recyclant les composants électroniques récupérés pour alimenter les systèmes vitaux de la base.

subject.archetype: Augmented Salvage Warrior - Electronic Recycler Combat Specialist

loadout.armor_outfit: Massively patched and welded mining space suit with asymmetrically mounted scrap metal plates from old cargo containers, duct-tape wrapped joints, exposed pressurized cables, improvised chest rig covered in salvaged circuit boards and copper coils, magnetic boots with sparking grounding cables, cracked welding helmet visor scratched and opaque with oil stains
loadout.arsenal: Jury-rigged kinetic mine-forge cannon cobbled from salvaged mining equipment with exposed copper wire IEM coils, duct-taped battery packs, and industrial plasma torch attachment; makeshift emp-grenade harness with exposed wiring

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in explosive low-gravity scrapyard warfare, standing in aggressive combat stance with weapon raised shoulder-high, one leg braced forward against floating debris, body coiled and ready to lunge, surrounded by rain of metallic fragments and sparks in zero-gravity chaos
attitude.emotion: Intense predatory focus through cracked visor, jaw clenched with adrenaline-fueled determination, covered in grease stains and welding burn marks, cybernetic eye augment glowing blue behind scratched lens

palette_names.name: Rusted Iron Orange
palette_names.role: Primary dominant color - corroded metal surfaces and armor plates

palette_names.name: Oxidized Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary color - hull plating and structural debris

palette_names.name: Industrial Black Grease
palette_names.role: Tertiary color - stains, shadows, and worn equipment

palette_names.name: Hot Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: Accent color - weapon energy, cybernetic glow, and sparks

palette_names.name: Molten Metal Amber
palette_names.role: Environmental accent - cascading liquid metal and burning rivers

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic mixed-source lighting with harsh blue plasma torch illumination, warm orange molten metal glow, sporadic muzzle flashes, and deep volumetric shadows from collapsing structures

camera.angle: Low angle dutch_angle - slightly tilted upward creating tension and hero dominance

scenography.setting: Massive hollowed asteroid interior scrapyard under siege - towering improvised spacecraft hull fragments stacked chaotically, ruptured fuel tanks spewing cascading rivers of molten orange metal, exposed station framework with sparking cables, hastily welded barricades buckling under weapons fire, debris field suspended in low gravity floating chaotically, background filled with burning wreckage and collapsing industrial structures
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Intense volumetric sparks showering from clashing improvised weapons, molten metal flowing in glowing rivers, dust particles and debris floating weightlessly, blue plasma torch flares, smoke wisps in zero-gravity, distant explosions illuminating with orange fire bursts, grinding metal sounds visualized through particle effects
